roadmap.landingHead.imageAlt: A hand-drawn RPG skill tree on a cream background with terracotta, gold, and sky nodes, the Windmill wordmark, and the tagline “Any goal, as a skill tree.”
roadmap.landingHead.offerDescription: All of Windmill, free: as many trees as you like, up to 10,000 steps in each, private trees, the whole editor, paste import, sharing, forking, export, and the MCP server with an API key. Roadmap AI assistance is being redesigned. Its allowance is not announced yet.
roadmap.landingHead.ogDescription: Turn any plan — redecorating a room, learning to bake, training for a 10k, shipping a side project — into a living RPG skill tree. Finish a step, watch the next branch unlock. Public beta, no account needed.
roadmap.landingHead.schemaBrowserRequire: Requires a browser with WebGL2 support
roadmap.landingHead.schemaDescription: Windmill renders any roadmap or goal as an animated RPG skill tree. Map your plan, finish a step to ripen its fruit, and watch dependent branches light up. No account needed — your first tree lives in your browser — and every tree is a shareable, forkable page.

roadmap.root.unlockText: Steps have real prerequisites, so the tree shows what you can work on now.
